0022600089.text: Both the Grizzlies and the Jazz are still waiting on their first games of 2026-27, so this is Memphis's season opener at home. Memphis will be without Isaiah Stewart, who is out with an ankle injury, while Utah is missing Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot) and Kyle Filipowski, who is day-to-day with a back issue and a game-time decision. The teams split their four 2025-26 meetings 2-2, and the most recent one was on April 10, 2026 in Utah, when the Grizzlies lost 147-101; ESPN's matchup predictor gives Memphis a 45% chance to win.
